jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Soylent

Soylent runs production inference for AI companies of every size. We combine applied research, flexible infrastructure and developer tooling so teams working at the frontier of AI can get new models to their users. We are growing quickly and are backed by several venture investors.

The Role

Hiring decides what Soylent becomes. In this role you will look for the places where recruiting loses time or quality, confirm each one with data, and then design and lead the fix. Some asks are small, like pulling numbers for leadership or answering an ATS question for a recruiter. Others run for months and need an executive sponsor. The scope runs from reworking how recruiting operates to shipping AI tools that recruiters use every day.

Responsibilities

  • Split large, fuzzy problems into phases with owners and deadlines, and stay with them until people actually adopt the change.

  • Run recruiting initiatives that involve many stakeholders: earn leadership support, keep timelines, and let data guide both the change and how you judge it.

  • Dig into interview loops, conversion between stages, time in stage and the load on interviewers, and turn the findings into specific recommendations.

  • Keep job setup and pipeline data clean so leadership can trust recruiting reports, and maintain the dashboards the team relies on.

  • Handle operational requests from recruiters and leaders, and turn repeated requests into self-serve tools or written answers.

  • Prototype and refine AI-assisted tools and workflows for recurring recruiting pain points.

  • Keep interview guides, playbooks and training material current and easy to find.

  • Suggest and roll out changes that speed recruiting up and make it more predictable, together with the communication and training needed for them to last.

Requirements

  • At least three years in recruiting operations, program management, or similar operations work at a company that was scaling quickly.

  • Experience leading cross-team projects from start to finish and getting senior leaders behind them.

  • Comfort pulling and analyzing data and presenting clear recommendations.

  • Concise writing for executive readers.

  • Strong prioritization across long-running programs and daily requests.

Nice to Have

  • Deep experience with an ATS, especially its reporting.

  • Experience creating tools or automations with AI assistants.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay with meaningful equity

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and dependents (US only)

  • Flexible time off, including a company-wide winter break

  • Paid parental leave

  • Family-building support

  • 401(k) plan (US only)

  • Exposure to many ML startups and the people building them

Soylent is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions do not depend on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other protected characteristic, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in line with applicable law, including local fair chance ordinances.
